confirmed_failure_classes.root_cause: Global lightweight defect-signal preflight was promoted into the account/entry hot path, while bootstrap/contract performance metadata still describes the startup hook as continuation-intent-only. The prose execution path is correct, but machine-readable scope metadata is contradictory.

Remote observed_* fields were removed from OWNER_REGISTRY, but BUSINESS adapter_status strings still embed mutable CI/PASS/PENDING/LIVE/current-assurance claims. This lets the sole membership authority accumulate stale operational evidence despite a dedicated observation cache.

The observation cache uses an undifferentiated control_signal_ref for both active and historical/resolved signals; A-share issue #2 remains open although the current Skill is 6,733 bytes (<8,192), while Financial points at already-closed issue #7.

preventive_findings.decision: No execution defect found because hot paths do not load it and version tests bind it; avoid promoting it to authority.

no_defect_or_bounded_findings: Single-writer lease verification and stale-writer fail-closed behavior are mechanically present.
Universal main material mutation uses active lease + observed-HEAD CAS; physical protection against an intentionally noncompliant authorized writer remains outside the declared threat model.
Bare inheritance derives participants from OWNER_REGISTRY, requires complete source quorum, labels partial discovery and does not auto-resume incomplete results.
Execution modes are now internal under one owner product entry; missing hard capability blocks the exact gate without redefining the owner SOP.

Artifact/context governance separates engineering authority, durable task state, evidence, cache, scratch, external reference and chat personalization; lower authority cannot silently overwrite current authority.
Old chat and Memory remain last-resort/non-authoritative recovery evidence.
Private owner CI runner non-execution and independent semantic/live-outcome assurance remain OPEN rather than falsely promoted.
